description: Small independent operator references for kernel conformance: embedding, LayerNorm, MatMul/Gemm, GELU, masked Softmax, and masked multi-head attention with an all-masked query row.

mask_policy.all_masked_row: A row whose additive mask is entirely -FLT_MAX produces a uniform distribution.  This is the GPT-2 ONNX mask convention and is stable under max-subtraction; it is not NaN.

provenance.producer: explicit float64 reference, rounded once to float32
